title: Agent tracing guidance lives in the setup.sh prompt, not the shared instrumentation skill
answers: where is the coding agent tracing checklist defined
where to change trace quality validation instructions for mlflow agent setup
does the shared instrumentation skill control agent setup guidance
body:
The ordered tracing checklist (understand, document, configure, instrument, verify, validate quality, report) is generated by build_agent_prompt in mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh.
This is setup-wizard orchestration guidance. PR #25547 explicitly did not change tracing APIs or the shared instrumentation skill, which lives in the MLflow Skills repository (github.com/mlflow/skills), not in this repo.
Checks the agent should run (autologging, session_id, token and cost, previews, duplicate spans, secret exposure) belong in build_agent_prompt. Framework-specific instrumentation how-to belongs in the shared skill.
The prompt tells agents to group executables that share one underlying agent into a single application, and to ask the user only when the repository has multiple independent agents.
applies: Deciding where agent-facing tracing guidance should be edited within mlflow agent setup.
says: Update the agent setup wizard checklist for validating trace quality and costs
Coding agent setup should prompt the user when multiple independent agents exist
Add token usage and secret exposure validation steps to agent onboarding flow

search: Agent-facing tracing guidance and setup checklist orchestration are defined by build_agent_prompt in mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh, not in the shared instrumentation skill. The prompt defines the tracing checklist and checks for autologging, session_id, token and cost, previews, duplicate spans, and secret exposure. Framework-specific instrumentation belongs in the external MLflow Skills repository (github.com/mlflow/skills), while the setup prompt instructs agents to group shared executables into one application.
